description: This file defines a Voice Wake Manager in Swift, handling speech recognition, audio buffer management, permissions, and related functionalities for voice activation features in an iOS app.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue to manage AVAudioPCMBuffer objects, enabling safe enqueueing and draining of buffers.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and microphone access for a voice-activated feature in the app.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback to enqueue audio buffers into a queue, used during audio tap installation.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer, supporting float, int16, and int32 channel data.

methods.name: configureAudioSession
methods.description: Configures the AVAudioSession for record and playback with specific options.

methods.name: requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests microphone access permission asynchronously, with a timeout.

methods.name: requestSpeechPermission
methods.description: Requests speech recognition permission asynchronously, with a timeout.

methods.name: permissionMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-facing message regarding permission status based on authorization.
